Entries.Original: Everyone, I know a lot happened this morning, but please remain calm and fight together during the mission.
Ooh, Vritika is stepping up to keep 31-X united!
Since you entrusted me with this role, I intend to see it through. Mmhm.
She says "mmhm". She is very motivated.
We'll take this mission and our coordination seriously, 'course.
Hmph. I will vent this anger on the Cancers.
Naturally. Defeating the Cancers is our mission.
So, what coordination are you thinking?
I have discussed it with Yingxia last night.
31-X's strengths lie in the power of our individual members, but everyone moves on their own, making it difficult to coordinate attacks.
As such, I have calculated the ideal time for coordination. Please move according to the order I have assigned you.
That is how Ruka and her squad always does...
And it is what we have been doing.
But this is a much faster pace. Faster than the Cancers can respond to.
This is a whole lot simpler than what I had in mind.
The very basics of coordinated strategy.
But this will raise the speed of my tactics, and we will be able to adopt a combat style that leverages 31-X's base rapid-attack capabilities.
Just by learning this coordination, we should shorten the time in which we eliminate a single Cancer by 63%.
So more than twice as fast? That's amazing.
...I see. I will try.
Okay, let's give it a shot, gals!
